from: July book, night 8 (The Chariot of Fire)
p1: Elijah and Elisha walked together. Elijah said, “Stay here.” But Elisha said, “I will not leave you.”
At the Jordan River, Elijah rolled up his big coat, called a mantle. He hit the water with it. The water opened, and they walked across on dry ground!
As they walked and talked, a chariot of fire came between them. It was a cart pulled by horses of fire! Elijah went up to heaven in a strong, spinning wind.
p2: Elijah’s mantle fell down. Elisha picked it up and hit the water, just as Elijah had. It opened again! The other prophets said, “Elijah’s spirit is on Elisha!”
Heavenly Father still gives us prophets today to help us follow Jesus. Tonight, think of someone good you can follow.
old: Elijah the prophet was very old. His helper Elisha loved him and stayed close by his side. Elisha would not leave Elijah, no matter what. They walked together as good friends.
They came to a river. Elijah rolled up his coat and hit the water. The river split apart so they could walk across on dry ground! Heavenly Father gave Elijah great power.
Suddenly a chariot of fire and horses of fire came down! Elijah went up, up, up to heaven in a whirlwind. Elisha watched in wonder. Then Elijah’s coat floated down to him.

Now Elisha became the new prophet. He picked up the coat and trusted God just like Elijah did. Heavenly Father always has a living prophet to lead His people. When one prophet finishes, another is ready to help us.
